text_block_list.text:
One day after training, after shopping in 
the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...It looks like the raffle venue is over 
this way."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought a lottery ticket 
would come as a bonus with a notebook...
choice_data_list: Is your schedule okay after this?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
As long as we cut down on travel time, 
it's not a problem. Above all—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I'm passing up a chance to 
get some great stories to tell my 
parents."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Japan's unique test of luck, the 
lottery... I look forward to seeing what 
it brings me.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: What're you aiming for, little lady?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Considering a fair trade for an entire 
notebook... perhaps one carrot will do.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Huh, that's rare coming from you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I believe testing one's luck is about 
enjoying the experience itself. Well then, 
here goes the spin.

With a tense look on her face, Eishin 
Flash turned the handle of the raffle 
wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hot springs...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes... but are you sure it's alright? For 
me to really have this...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
You're so humble, little lady, God must've 
given you a little bonus. You'd be losing 
out if you didn't take it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ... Then I shall gratefully accept.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Fufu, hot springs...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Actually, Germany is just as big on 
hot springs as Japan is.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The water temperature is lower than in 
Japan, so you won't get dizzy from the 
heat and can enjoy soaking all day long.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“Still, ever since coming to Japan, I 
haven't had much of a chance to go.”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So... I'm genuinely happy.
choice_data_list: Then I'd love to just soak leisurely.
Then it'd be nice to just soak leisurely.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Relaxing...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. Could you hold onto this 
ticket for me?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, we cannot fit that into our 
immediate schedule."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Next year, once everything is 
wrapped up, we should have plenty of time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the current me cannot write "Hot 
Springs Trip" in my planner with an orange 
pen.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So, once all the plans are finished, could 
you be the one to hand it over, Trainer?

And so, I ended up holding onto the hot 
spring trip voucher.
choice_data_list: By the way, what's up with the orange pen?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I make sure to write down the schedules 
I'm looking forward to in orange.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's just an old habit of mine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, you're smiling, aren't you? 
Does the orange look weird?"
choice_data_list: I just thought the color-coding is so cute

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Please try it yourself next time, 
Trainer. You will understand just how 
rational a decision it is."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, a schedule should be 
written with great detail. When text and 
lines become densely packed, color-coding 
them is—

...And so, on the way home, it ultimately 
turned into a schedule-planning lecture by 
Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My, that looks delicious...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course! After all, it's a dish of 
German origin!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"As a result, I expect high standards for 
the taste. Let us see if it truly lives up 
to the title of 'Special Grade.'"
And so, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ――...*munch*. *chew*, *chew*...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...! Delicious!

The Japanese Hamburg steak scored a 
magnificent 100 out of 100 points.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, this is quite a heaping 
portion. How many kilograms is it exactly?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Who knows... I packed the box to the brim, 
so I've got no clue.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...So profitability is completely out the 
window, is it? We must reward those 
feelings in kind."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have decided. Let us make a Rüblitorte.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's Swiss carrot cake. The carrot flavor 
really stands out, making it delicious.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"My parents once taught me a modified 
recipe that doesn't use butter."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"We won't be able to finish eating all 
this ourselves, so here—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Flash-san, the oven is ready~♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've got the batter ready on my end too. 
Let's go ahead and bake four whole cakes 
at a time.

Later on, I was treated to some of the 
carrot cake she baked with the dorm 
girls—and thoroughly savored every 
delicious bite.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Just as planned. It's a wonderful result.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
You really are an unusual girl, young 
lady...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you happen to know the recipe that 
makes the best use of this carrot?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I can only think of recipes 
that end up making awkward serving sizes."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Then I'll call my ma over! Heyyy, 
Maaa!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, really, you don't have to go that 
far—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, I heard you! Let's see, 
carrot recipes, right!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Woman
text_block_list.text:
"I just finished making some, so come on 
inside and have a taste!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh, what...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Woman
text_block_list.text:
Experience is the best teacher, right? 
Wait, is that not the right phrase? Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: I'll gladly accept your kind offer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll be in your care...?

And so, Eishin Flash received loving 
cooking lessons from the folks at the 
shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I really am a... pechvogel, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It means a "pitiful person."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Statistically speaking, drawing a dud 
is always a possibility."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I understand it logically, however...

Understanding something isn't the same as 
accepting it. Eishin Flash felt 
disheartened.
